scope: Rhee backbone / anti-collaboration committee actor identity

findings.claim: A secondary roster preserves the ten Special Investigation Committee members with region and Hanja: Kim Sang-deok(金尙德, Gyeongbuk), Kim Sang-don(金相敦, Seoul), Jo Jung-hyeon(趙重顯, Gyeonggi), Park Woo-gyeong(朴愚京, Chungbuk), Kim Myeong-dong(金明東, Chungnam), Oh Gi-yeol(吳基烈, Jeonbuk), Kim Jun-yeon(金俊淵, Jeonnam), Kim Hyo-seok(金孝錫, Gyeongnam), Lee Jong-sun(李鐘淳, Gangwon), Kim Gyeong-bae(金庚培, Jeju/Hwanghae).
findings.note: Useful identity discriminator, but not promoted to primary evidence until National Assembly stenographic record is recovered. This materially corrects Pass 176's risk of conflating Jo Jung-hyeon with painter 趙重顯 and Lee Jong-sun with later politician 李鍾純. The roster itself gives 李鐘淳, a different Hanja spelling.

findings.claim: Kim Sang-don was already vice-chair of the Special Investigation Committee in 1949, so an encyclopedia chronology placing that role in 1951 is not safe to ingest without correction history.
findings.note: The Institute for Research in Collaborationist Activities reproduces Kim Sang-don's 1957 Jin-sang article and identifies him as the committee vice-chair in 1949. Still seek the 1948 National Assembly election/organization record as primary confirmation.

findings.claim: Kim Hyo-seok's later executive career is independently corroborated as vice minister then third Minister of Home Affairs in 1949, requiring a timeline split from his earlier National Assembly/Special Investigation Committee role.
findings.note: Do not infer responsibility for individual anti-collaboration investigations from later Home Ministry office without action-level evidence.

identity_corrections.warning: The same Hanja is used by the 1917-1982 painter in AKS. Hanja alone therefore does not resolve identity. Require district/Assembly roster/biographical linkage before stable-node promotion.
Do not merge with the later politician commonly rendered 李鍾純. The secondary committee roster supplies a materially different final character. Primary Assembly record is required.
